retrieved_context: Kwame Kilpatrick: Kwame Malik Kilpatrick (born June 8, 1970) is an American former politician, having served as a Democratic Michigan state representative and mayor of Detroit from 2002 to 2008.  He resigned as mayor in September 2008 after being convicted of perjury and obstruction of justice.  Kilpatrick was sentenced to four months in jail and was released on probation after serving 99 days.

Detroit mayoral election, 2009: The Detroit mayoral elections of 2009 took place on May 5, 2009, with a primary on February 24, 2009 to fill the vacancy created when Kwame Kilpatrick resigned as mayor.
